articles.headline: Joe Morgan, who inspired 'Morgan Magic' with Red Sox, dies
articles.description: Joe Morgan, the former Boston manager who inspired a magical in-season turnaround of its 1988 team, died Saturday, the Red Sox announced.

images.name: Joe Morgan photodesk [1296x1296]
images.caption: Joe Morgan spent 18 seasons in the Red Sox organization and is a member of its hall of fame.

articles.headline: Braves' Ronald Acuña Jr. does curtain call amid boos in Philly
articles.description: Ronald Acuna Jr. gave the irate Phillies fans a curtain call after hitting a tying three-run homer, and the Braves used a late rally to defeat Philadelphia 5-4 on Sunday, extending their lead in the NL East to five games.
